item.title: CTA Red Line station shooting: 18-year-old suspect charged after 2 injured
item.description: A recent shooting at a CTA Red Line station wounded two men, as the transit agency faces a deadline to improve safety on public transportation.Violence interrupters stopped riders exiting the CTA Red Line at 79th Street. They say they’ll be riding trains at all hours to be vigilant for the public.That Red Line station is where a double shooting took place early Sunday morning.Police say a group got into an argument that escalated to gun violence. Two men in their twenties were seriously wounded.
